nodes.label: docs/canon/raw/rejected_sample.md — the laptop filter's discard sample: rejected turns shown in full, each headed by the rule that rejected it, its timestamp and its session file. Read it to judge the filter by what it threw away rather than by its own tallies

The seven laptop reject rules appearing in the sample, each machine-authored rather than typed by the human: `harness_template` (the largest bucket at 6,380), `tool_result`, `is_meta`, `task_notification`, `command_expansion`, `interrupt_marker`, and `headless_directory`. The samples are rotated across rules and dates so each rule can be judged on several instances
